body:
Today I am going to write about a holocaust not many people are familiar
with or care about: The Iraqi holocaust.  The power the media have to shape
and mold the minds of the public is incredible.  The public already has a
preconceived notion of who are worthy of more consideration during times of
suffering or misfortune, due to the use of advanced psychological techniques
by media elites.  The Iraqis we fought against during Bush's Persian Gulf
War are suffering as a result of the murderous sanctions imposed by the
U.S., and they deserve it every bit because of their evil, their wickedness,
many believe.  The Iraqis just aren't a people to commiserate over when they
suffer; they brought it on themselves, after all.

Well, I am going to give a picture perhaps some of you have not seen.
Recently, members of the congressional staff visited United Nations
officials, Iraqi government officials, and non-government relief groups to
survey the humanitarian crises affecting the Iraqi population.  What they
found is reprehensible: Desperately malnourished babies are dying of
treatable diseases formerly eradicated from Iraq; barefoot children walk in
raw sewage surrounding their housing complexes; families live on meager
government rations; and medicine is in short supply.

Nine years of United Nations sanctions are doing nothing to hurt Saddam
Hussein, but instead is killing innocent women and children.  Since the end
of Operation Desert Storm, more than one million Iraqis have died as a
direct result of the sanctions.  According to UNICEF, 4,500 Iraqi children
under the age of 5 die each month.  Additionally, the number of Iraqi
children with cancer has increased sevenfold.  Doctors blame the surge on
depleted uranium used in U.S. and British tank-piercing shells during the
Gulf War.

When asked about Iraqi children dying as a result of the U.S. embargo, U.S.
Secretary of State Madeleine Albright said: "It's a hard decision, but we
think the price... is worth it."  Since she made that statement, about
500,000 Iraqis, mostly children, have died.

What if these children were Jews?  Jews would be screaming "holocaust!"  The
Jewish elites would use this to further their agenda; they would portray the
Jews as victims.  Why aren't Jewish and White liberal arts professors in the
humanities departments of universities condemning this?  Why isn't the media
to denouncing this nefarious campaign against Iraqi civilians?  Where are
the uppity, White, suburban liberals to protest the killing of children?
They had the guts to protest the Viet Nam War, when their very own lives
were at risk, as potential conscripts.

Alas, we now know the true colors of the White liberal pussies who play
themselves off as rebels.  They only care for themselves, to appear
fashionable.  They don't give a damn about innocent children.  Just as
Vladimir Lenin didn't give a damn about the proletarians.  As one of my
history professors pointed out: "He would have killed his own relatives if
he knew he could get something from it."  Lenin was a power-monger.

One million dead as a result of U.S. sanctions.  God forbid this happen to
Jews!  We would hear this for hundreds if not thousands of years, replayed
and rehashed over and over for students to learn "never again."  Of course,
never again to Jews and Jews only!  Just look at how the Jews are
slaughtering the Palestinians, brazenly proclaiming themselves to be victims
to the White American public.  We never hear a peep from Jew liberals in
America about the situation of the Palestinians.  Moreover, they will not
admit the significant Jewish role in the black slave trade.

Regards,
Pyro
